architectures.transparent: scores the generated stream under baseline Lambda-bar
architectures.represented: marginalizes Lambda using the noisy metacognitive allocation observation
architectures.represented_limitation_resolution: metacognitive allocation observation with reliability swept over 0.60, 0.80, and 0.95
architectures.raw_stream_identity: transparent and represented architectures replay the same serialized stream

estimands.delivered_effective_precision: absolute channel log-likelihood-ratio separation, zero when masked
estimands.counterfactual_disconfirming_influence: posterior-logit difference for a disconfirming token versus the same channel masked
estimands.selection_filtering_signature: selection-naive minus selection-aware log Bayes factor
estimands.hysteresis_area: sum over cue grid of positive down-curve minus up-curve times 0.25
estimands.capture_on: first upward cue level with q(B)>=0.70
estimands.release: first descending cue level with q(B)<0.50
estimands.recovery_time: slices after final withdrawal until q(B)<0.30

panel_rule.selection: first lexicographic parameter cell in each occupied region; report any empty region without substitution
